text:
alex: Heads up — finalizing session owners & hybrid flow for the annual planning retreat next Thu. Need owners for 4 breakouts + AV/host for hybrid room. Can folks claim? cc @maya @devon @sam

maya: I can take Breakout A (Roadmap sequencing). Will need ~30m prep with leads. @rachel you good to co-host?

devon: Ill take Breakout C (OKRs & success metrics). Need the slide deck template. @jamie can you confirm projector + stream setup?

sam: I can be hybrid host for the main room. Please drop the Teams link in this thread and Ill pin it. Also need a short run-of-show.

rachel: Co-host for A yes. Ill collect prompts from product leads by Mon EOD and assemble a one-pager.

ops-bot: AV booking pending — checking room capacity and stream ops.

jamie: Ops update: AV booking confirmed for Main + Room B. Projector in Room C requires HDMI dongle (we have one). Wired mics reserved. RT1 stream slot reserved Thu 8:30-16:00.

ajamie: I booked the dongle and will be onsite at 8:30 to test. Whoever is hybrid host, ping me Thu 8:30.

alex: Draft run-of-show (proposal):
```
09:00-09:20 All-hands (announcements + kickoff)
09:30-10:20 Breakout round 1 (two parallel rounds)
10:35-11:25 Breakout round 2
12:30-14:30 Synthesis + prioritization
```
Any tweaks? thinking of trimming all-hands to 20 to keep energy.

maya: +1 to 20m all-hands. Shorter is better. Also can we allocate a 10-min buffer between sessions for people to move/switch.

devon: OKR breakout plan — will use this quick template for notes:
```
Problem
Goal (quarter)
Success metrics
Top bets
Risks & mitigations
Owners
```
Share bullets by Tue so I can pre-seed the doc.

sam: Teams link (placeholder): https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/xxxx — Ill update with the real join once calendar invite is live and pin it.

alex: Owners so far: Maya+Rachel (A), Devon (C), Sam (hybrid host/main room). Still need: Breakout B (Customer signals) and Breakout D (Infrastructure & ops). @lia can you take D?

lia: I can take D but would like an eng-infra co-host. @dev-ops-mike? Also request 10 min to present infra SLO changes during that breakout.

devon: noted re: SLO slot. Also propose we use separate Miro boards per breakout for sticky-note capture. Jamie — can you create 4 boards and share links?

jamie: Done — 4 Miro boards created and linked in the event doc. Ill paste links into the calendar invite and the retreat doc.

alex: Action items summary (I'll ship final plan EOD Fri if no objections):
- Maya: collect prompts & one-pager for Breakout A (due Mon EOD)
- Devon: share OKR template & pre-seed doc (due Tue)
- Lia: secure infra co-host & prepare SLO slides
- Jamie: confirm AV + Miro links + onsite ops checklist
- Sam: publish Teams link and final run-of-show in calendar invite

rachel: :thumbsup: sounds good. Ill follow up with leads to get prompts.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created and sent to event attendees. Rooms and links attached.

alex: Thanks all — if you pick up an action please reply here so I can mark owners. Planning to lock the breakout owners and run-of-show by EOD Fri.
